messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: p99 latency breach detected for streaming route /v1/stream (service: inference-runtime). Current p99=3.2s (SLO=1.2s). Auto-escalation to #incidents. :rotating_light:

oncall_amy: saw it — heading in. Any deploys in the last 20m?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed by runtime_max at 6123456700: rollout: precision-profile-update -> redwood-mix-1.0 (int8, fp8 mixed)

runtime_max: yea pushed a precision profile tweak to reduce tail mem pressure. rolling config to 30% traffic. didn't expect this spike.

eng_sre_jordan: grabbing p95/p99 traces and traces per model. Can someone dump streamer logs (kv-cache hitrate, ongoing sessions)?

runtime_max: fetching now, past 10m aggregated: 
```
model: redwood-mix-1.0
stream_sessions: 42k
p95: 0.9s
p99: 3.2s
kv_cache_hit: 71% -> 48% (drop coincides with deploy)
active_workers_per_slot: stable
queue_depth: +22% on long-context lanes
```

ml_inference_sara: kv cache drop smells like dequantization mismatch or kv key layout change due to new kernel path. int8 path could be flushing profiles during calibration. Did we enable any live calib?

runtime_max: enabled auto-calib=true in the new profile. It runs lightweight calibrations when new quant path hits.

eng_sre_jordan: OK that lines up. Streaming tail stalls often come from intermittent KV cache misses + dequant latency. Support, any customer hits?

support_lee: CS reports 3 customers with streaming timeouts, one high-traffic SaaS partner (#acme) seeing intermittent 504s and stuck client streams. Logged as INC-5432.

cs-mgr_oliver: flagged to account team. This partner is on Dedicated but uses mixed runtime; they reported degraded p99 since ~6123456720.

oncall_amy: priority: mitigate to SLO quickly. Proposed actions: 1) rollback precision profile (route 30% back to previous profile) 2) divert streaming traffic to fallback model variant (redwood-stable-1.0) for sensitive routes 3) pause auto-calib. Who can run rollback?

runtime_max: I can roll back the profile on the fleet. Command: `rdwctl profiles rollback --name redwood-mix-1.0 --target previous --scope streaming --batch 0.5`  — will start now, should take ~120s to propagate to nodes.

ml_inference_sara: also flipping `auto_calib=false` on the new profile.

eng_sre_jordan: I'll open a temporary routing rule to divert /v1/stream for enterprise tiers to redwood-stable-1.0. `routerctl set-route /v1/stream --fallback redwood-stable-1.0 --percent 40 --immediate`

runtime_max: rollback triggered. Watching metrics.

(45s later)

runtime_max: rollback completed on 60% of nodes. p99 trending down: 2.1s

eng_sre_jordan: routing change applied. diverted 40% enterprise traffic. KV hit stabilizing on nodes that rolled back.

support_lee: CS confirms partner #acme reports improvement on some sessions but still intermittent failures on legacy clients.

runtime_max: continuing roll forward to previous profile on remaining nodes.

(2m later)

runtime_max: rollback finished cluster-wide. p95=0.85s p99=1.05s (within SLO). queue_depth normalized. kv_cache_hit back to ~72%.

incident-bot: UPDATE: p99 back within SLO. Incident status -> mitigated.

oncall_amy: great. Action items: 1) keep routing fallback for 1 hour to catch stragglers 2) disable auto-calib feature for mixed-precision until we have a safe rollout plan 3) ML to reproduce calibration-induced kv eviction locally 4) postmortem + exec summary for CS.

ml_inference_sara: will create a repro harness and capture kernel traces. Suspect path: int8 dequant path triggers a synchronous memory reformat causing KV GC on a subset of batches. Need heap and scheduler traces.

eng_sre_jordan: I'll collect flamegraphs for the streaming runtime from the window and attach logs.

support_lee: CS asked for a short customer note: can we confirm cause & mitigation?

oncall_amy: cause: precision-profile auto-calibration triggered a runtime path change that lowered kv-cache hit rates and introduced intermittent dequant stalls on streaming long-context lanes. mitigation: profile rollback + routing fallback + paused auto-calib. Impact: some enterprise streaming sessions saw timeouts and elevated p99 (up to 3.2s) for ~3.5 minutes; no data loss, requests retried/timeout returned 504 for a minority of sessions.

cs-mgr_oliver: good. I'll send a brief to the partner: timeline + mitigation + we will follow up with RCA and preventive plan.

runtime_max: follow-ups I'll own: add deploy-time guardrails to avoid auto-calib on live streaming fleets, add a canary ramp and health-check that watches kv_cache_hit and p99 before increasing percent.

ml_inference_sara: I'll schedule a deep-dive with runtime and SRE to instrument calibration path and create a synthetic workload that exercises long-context streaming with dequant.

eng_sre_jordan: filing incident doc and tagging components: runtime/serving, quantization, routing. Setting severity to Sev3 (short SLO breach, mitigated).

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: mitigated -> postmortem pending.

oncall_amy: thanks everyone. We'll run RCA tomorrow 1400 UTC. If anyone has logs or repros drop them into the incident doc. :thumbsup:
